newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Apple cuts Singapore staff by 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Apple cuts Singapore staff by 10 pct.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc said on Friday it had slashed its Singapore workforce by nearly 10 percent, shedding 101 position to reduce its staff to 872.
The company said in a statement it had also closed its Apple Design Centre in Singapore.
It said the restructuring was designed to increase efficiency in its manufacturing operations and consolidate research and development efforts at its headquarters in Cupertino, California.

"The restructure is in line with the recent announcements by Apple Computer Inc to implement a more streamlined organisation to return the company to sustainable profitability," it quoted Peter Tan, the managing director of Apple Computer Ltd in Singapore, as saying.
Apple said its commitment to Asia remained strong. It said its Asian shipments for the first quarter of 1997 had increased significantly.
"There will be no lay-offs in the sales and marketing organisation in Apple's Asian offices," the statement said.
Apple Design Centre was set up in 1993 to design a range of circuits, products and software associated with them.
